row: Healing Effects Animal Massage is a mobile in-home service focusing on a holistic approach to your furry family member’s health care through massage therapy. I am Margaret Taormina, a double certified and insured small animal massage practitioner who is an advocate for therapeutic massage for both humans and our animal companions.
